title: Alms on the step
prose: On the worn middle of the bottom step, where feet have dished the stone, somebody has set a leaf of cooked rice and a clay lamp, still warm. Nobody is in sight. The names cut along the riser above it are too worn to read with the eyes; you find them with your fingers, a few at a time. Whoever left the rice left it for whoever came next.

choices.label: Leave something of your own
choices.line: You leave a pinch of what you carry beside the lamp. It is not the rice that matters, you think, but that the step is never bare.

choices.label: Find the names with your fingers
choices.line: Seven names you can make out, and a gap where an eighth was cut away on purpose. You copy the seven into the diary, and the gap.

notes: The owner's ask of 4 October 2026: a card on reaching the Alms Step, the temple on the first sky island, with a painting the owner will provide (`happening_alms_on_the_step`). Drafted by Claude for the owner to rewrite. Guyuk's beat at the same place (`Water at the Alms Step`) comes first when it is due, as story beats always do.
